title: EMA Trend Gate on BTC — Multi-Timeframe Regime-Filtered Pullback
objective: Test the EMA Trend Gate strategy (4h EMA regime filter + 1h RSI pullback entries) on BTCUSDT 1h data (43,789 bars, ~5 years from 2021-03-22 to 2026-03-21). The strategy generated 0.528 OOS Sharpe on ETH with 1216 trades; hypothesis is BTC's higher volatility will generate more trade opportunities and potentially higher risk-adjusted returns.
hypothesis: BTC's higher volatility compared to ETH will generate more RSI pullback trade opportunities (target: >14.3 trades/window) and potentially higher risk-adjusted returns (target: OOS Sharpe >= 0.528, matching or exceeding ETH baseline).
strategy_rationale: Using existing EMA Trend Gate strategy that already demonstrated viability on ETH (0.528 OOS Sharpe, 85 windows, 1216 trades). This run tests cross-asset generalization to BTC, the highest-liquidity crypto pair. The strategy uses 4h EMA slope as regime filter (trending vs ranging) combined with 1h RSI pullback entries.

data_acquisition.reason: Deep BTC data already exists in workspace/data/binance_btcusdt_1h_deep.csv with 43,789 rows spanning 2021-03-22 to 2026-03-21.
